## RB Bragantino v Chapecoense: Sudamericana push meets relegation fight

RB Bragantino host Chapecoense in the Brasileirão on Wednesday, 28 October 2026 at Estádio Municipal Cícero de Souza Marques, with the hosts eyeing a Copa Sudamericana berth and the visitors battling to avoid the drop. [...] Massa Bruta are without suspended pair Gabriel and goalkeeper Tiago Volpi, while Henry Mosquera, Rodriguinho and Davi Gomes are injured. Verdão do Oeste miss suspended midfielders Yago and Camilo, with Heitor, Vinicius Lourenço, Rafael Carvalheira and Robert sidelined. [...] A home win would move Braga to 44 points and strengthen their top half and Sudamericana push. Victory for Chape would lift them to 24 points and keep their survival bid alive, while a draw would still leave them fighting in the relegation zone.
